proves.claim: With health.derivedState on and the table current for main, next answers the same item as with it off, and an item the table names gate-at-head is not offered.

cli.journeys-next-derived-state.a-curren.why: Without it, a regression where next ignores the derived-state table, or offers an item the table says is gated, would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: With the table swept at an older main, or with the setting off, next computes gate-at-head itself and answers the same item.

cli.journeys-next-derived-state.an-older.why: Without it, a regression where next reads a table that is not current for main would pass unnoticed.
